# Project Design Context

## Project

- Name: haller-haven-demo
- Product: Static marketing/demo site for Haller Immobilienberatung GmbH (Andernach)
- Stack: Multi-page HTML + vanilla JS + custom CSS (no React/Tailwind)
- Color mode: light
- Density: comfortable

## Tokens (`site.css` `:root`)

| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `--bg` | `#F8F8F8` |
| `--card` | `#FFFFFF` |
| `--line` | `#E2E2E2` |
| `--txt` | `#222222` |
| `--mut` | `#6B6B6B` |
| `--acc` | `#0073E1` |
| `--acc-deep` | `#5472D2` |
| `--ghost` | `#959898` |
| `--pad-x` | `clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px)` (mobile override below 900px) |
| `--pad-y` | `clamp(80px, 10vw, 120px)` (mobile override below 900px) |
| `--content` | `1280px` |

Typography: Inter (UI) + Fraunces (quotes/acrostic).

## Breakpoints

- Nav desktop: `min-width: 901px`
- Content stack: `max-width: 900px`
- Hero quote/acrostic stack: `max-width: 720px`
- Listing gallery: `max-width: 700px`

## Preferred primitives

`.btn`, `.btn.ghost`, `.card`, `.listing-card`, `.listing-filter`, `.wrap`, `.section`, `.top`, `#site-nav`

## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve German copy and Haller brand colors
- Reuse existing CSS class primitives
- Prefer token overrides over one-off pixels
- Tap targets ≥ 44px on mobile; safe-area insets on chrome

### Avoid

- React/shadcn conversion
- Silent redesign / sticky glass nav / fixed call bar (subjective; see Haller_update.md)
